sim_config.text:
# Rudin arm + OUR disturbance curriculum, continued from the height-corrected
# policy. Fourth column of the comparison: it answers whether our arm's margin
# comes from the WBC structure or from having trained on the evaluated
# disturbance distribution.
#
# Base is the exact recipe's simulator/control stack (envpool_train_rudin.toml).
# The ONLY change is the disturbance: legged_gym's push_robots is turned off at
# the trainer (--no-push) and replaced by the cardinal velocity-kick curriculum
# of envpool_train_v3_card_f.toml, copied verbatim below.
#
# Copied, not %include'd: card_f inherits v1 -> Gamma5 -> envpool.toml, whose
# WBC control stack would overwrite this arm's max_torque, command source and
# joint-PD gains.
#
# ONSET. The end-to-end policy has no gait scheduler, so MdlSimDriver's phase
# onset has no source. external_force_fallback_phase_period gives it the same
# 0.4 s test-protocol clock the rudin ladders already use
# (evaluations/core/_rl_eval.py, RSL_FALLBACK_PHASE_PERIOD). With
# onset_cycle = 3 the first pulse lands no earlier than 1.2 s into an episode.
#
# DECLARED DEVIATION: at a 3.0 m/s six-direction ceiling this is NOT Rudin et
# al.'s recipe, whose domain_rand.max_push_vel_xy is 1.0 m/s and x/y only. It
# must be reported as a curriculum-matched ablation, never as the baseline.
%include envpool_train_rudin.toml

[simulation]
external_force_enable = true
external_force_mode = "random"
external_force_type = "velocity"
external_push_semantics = "add"
external_force_cardinal = true
# fwd, back, left, right, up, down -- m/s, not N.s: under type = "velocity" the
# drawn magnitude IS the kick (the on_duration denominator is 1.0).
external_force_impulses = [3.0, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0]
external_force_noforce_probability = 0.2
external_force_on_duration = 0.2
external_force_off_duration = 1.4
external_force_curriculum_enable = false
external_force_fallback_phase_period = 0.4

# REQUIRED, not decorative. envpool.toml sets external_force_max = [40, 40, 20]
# in NEWTONS; under type = "velocity" MdlSimDriver reads that key as m/s in
# "random" mode and throws on anything past 20 (MdlSimDriver.cc:804). The
# cardinal sampler uses external_force_impulses above, so this value only has
# to be in-unit and consistent.
external_force_max = [3.0, 3.0, 3.0]
